name: Effective VC Radius of the Interpolation/Effective-VC-Radius Counterexample
proof: All three coordinates are effective, and every two-coordinate projection is the full two-cube, so every pair is shattered. The full three-coordinate trace has only four concepts and is not shattered. Thus $\mathrm{VCR}=2$, as checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_interpolation\_conjecture.py}$.
